title: Wgpu Theme Cursor Parity
description: Wgpu renderer cursor parity with React: theme-aware custom SVG cursors (selectable, grab, resize, text, etc.) applied to canvas based on hit targets and drag state.
summary: Fixed dock window split resize: resize hits register after window content with 20px min targets, axis math uses row/column bounds, DockSplit/DockJoinCorner hit kinds with correct ew/ns/move cursors.
